findings: Actual result and source fidelity: In source-review-packet/proposal/candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs, init::project constructs source.mori, scenario.json, mori-tests.json, and README.md in memory using asset TEST (network local, issuer mori-init-example, reference TEST, scale 0) for Transfer (pay 25, post balances alice 75 and bob 25) and Repay (seed and repay 30, post balances alice 70 and bob 30, debt liability 100 to 70), while init::run uses std::fs::create_dir and OpenOptions::create_new(true) without create_dir_all so existing files, directories, and symlinks are refused and missing parents are not created. Receipt pairs actual-cycle/red/{START,RESULT,STDOUT,STDERR}.json/.log (historical single-test failure on bare mori with child shell exit 127 and Cargo exit 101, 1 failed and 7 filtered) and actual-cycle/green/{START,RESULT,STDOUT,STDERR}.json/.log (distinct source/test bytes running the full --no-default-features --test init target with 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 filtered, exit 0) match REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json.

Current public path and shell assertion: init::run resolves the creating binary via std::env::current_exe(), enforces UTF-8 with to_str(), and formats a single-quoted POSIX shell word inline via format!("'{}'", executable.replace('\'', "'\\''")) without any separate quote_arg helper. In source-review-packet/proposal/candidate/crates/mori/tests/init.rs, generated_commands_use_the_creating_rust_cli_without_path_lookup resolves and fs::canonicalize-s host sh from PATH before clearing child PATH, copies the binary into "Rust CLI's tools 🧪/mori", runs init and the README.md sh block under sh -c "set -e\n..." with PATH="", and verifies the three sequential JSON reports in actual-cycle/green/cli-captures/cli-574969-20/stdout and actual-cycle/green/cli-captures/cli-574969-22/stdout against the public check, simulate, and test contracts in source-review-packet/PUBLIC-CONSUMER-EXCERPTS.md.

Finite independent financial scope: actual-cycle/green/INDEPENDENT-FINANCIAL-COMPARISON.json and FROZEN-POST-EFFECTS-PROJECTION.json confirm 13 mechanical matches of complete post snapshots and ordered effects against the first pre-execution freeze (source-review-packet/finance-freezes/clean-devex-fresh-independent-oracles/{FREEZE,BASIS}.json, LIMITATIONS.md, transfer.expected.json, repay.expected.json) for Transfer 25 and Repay 30. The extra pre-execution freeze (source-review-packet/finance-freezes/clean-devex-init-extra-independent-oracles/{FREEZE,BASIS}.json and four *.expected.json files) covers full repayment 100 (retaining zero-amount alice balance and zero-amount debt tombstone) and three atomic refusals (repay 30 on debt 20, pay 0, pay 101 on balance 100) tested in repayment_full_tombstone_and_overdischarge_preserve_atomic_reference_results and transfer_zero_and_unfunded_are_exact_reference_refusals; test helper expected() is not independent, and exact error codes, source_hash, per-step traces, and full Execution/CLI rendering are not independently oracle-qualified.

Captures, cleanup, platform, and advisory boundaries: Across 34 top-level MORI_INIT_CAPTURE_DIR directories and 21 parsed top-level JSON reports, shell wrapper captures cli-574969-20 and cli-574969-22 each run 3 nested mori commands, whereas competing_inits_have_one_complete_winner_without_overwrite spawns 2 competing init processes directly outside invoke() (leaving no cli-574969-13 capture directory and producing the race loser destination-directory refusal "File exists (os error 17)" on .../mori-init-574969-13/race in actual-cycle/green/STDERR.log). PROCESS-CLEANUP.json and CLEANUP.json in actual-cycle/{red,green} verify only empty owned sessions and removed owned temporary roots on Linux with /usr/bin/dash (no Windows/Git Bash qualification or detached/syscall exclusion), and security judgments—including the designated source owner's a2 classification of control/backtick README presentation and non-UTF-8 path coverage as advisory—are deferred to the designated owner.

Guarded integration: This approval is strictly scoped to the exact candidate files and observed RED/GREEN receipts bound by REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json. Prior a1 result reviews remain ineligible for source, scope, or identity substitutions, source-owner a2 approvals are not result votes, and Root alone must verify current main and selected consumer/dependency byte identity (including any advances from PR210 or separate Core2 tests/fixtures) and rebase or re-review any changed bytes before integration.
limitations: Observed execution is limited to Linux (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) with /usr/bin/dash and --no-default-features; no Windows, Git Bash, or native/SDK/VM/proof/ledger/wallet execution was observed or qualified.

Independent financial comparison is bounded to 13 complete post and ordered effects matches from the first freeze (Transfer 25 and Repay 30) plus the extra freeze's finite full-repayment (100) and three atomic refusal predictions; full Execution wire structure, step ExprId/value traces, source_hash, exact error codes, logical metering, and CLI formatting are not independently qualified.

Capture accounting reflects 34 top-level invoke() directories (21 parsed top-level JSON reports), with 6 nested Rust CLI invocations inside shell wrappers cli-574969-20 and cli-574969-22 and 2 direct-spawned race children in competing_inits_have_one_complete_winner_without_overwrite outside invoke() (no cli-574969-13 capture directory).

actual-cycle/{red,green}/PROCESS-CLEANUP.json and CLEANUP.json establish only post-run emptiness of the owned session and removal of the owned temporary root directory, not syscall-level or detached-process exclusion.

Security assessments and the designated source owner's advisory disposition of control/backtick README presentation and non-UTF-8 executable path handling are deferred to the designated owner; integration into main remains guarded by Root verification of actual current base and dependency bytes.
summary: Approve the scoped SDK-free mori init actual result bound in REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json: candidate source files crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs and crates/mori/tests/init.rs, observed RED single-test failure and GREEN 8-test pass receipts, shell wrapper streams, and 13 independent post/effects financial matches are mutually consistent within the documented Linux/dash, owned-cleanup, non-security, and guarded-integration boundaries.
